prayerExcerpt.en-US: It was more reasonable to obey the immortal King of heaven and earth than a mortal prince.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Era mais razoável obedecer ao imortal Rei do céu e da terra do que a um príncipe mortal.

meta.face: Two clearly different Persians with warm, light-brown skin. JONAS (left): about twenty-five, with a SQUARE-JAWED, BROAD young face — thick, straight black brows almost MEETING over the nose, large, dark almond eyes, a straight, strong nose, full lips, a firm, square chin; thick, wavy black hair to the nape; only a faint shadow of first beard; the gaze bright and eager, toward us. BARACHISIUS (right): about forty, with a LONG, GAUNT, hollow-cheeked face — a high, narrow forehead, a large AQUILINE nose, deep-set, dark eyes under heavy lids, prominent cheekbones, a narrow mouth; brown hair cut short; a long, straight, THIN brown beard falling in stiff, sparse strands; the gaze lifted, fervent.
meta.basis: No likenesses survive. The Painter's Manual (martyrdoms of March, 27th) gives 'Jonah a young man and the other has a brown, rush-like beard', and the card follows it. The book tells their visit to the condemned, their answer, and Jonas set in a frozen pond; its engraving shows them seized by soldiers. The faces' structures are our choice.
